resolved.Name: S4b
resolved.Title: unregister destination, orphan TTL -> DLQ
resolved.Description: soar is unregistered through the admin API at 60s and never comes back. Its in-flight batch completes, the rest of its queue and every later event for it are parked (NotActive) and, after orphan_ttl = 30 s, moved to the DLQ by the sweeper with reason orphan_ttl_expired. Nothing may be lost; the other sinks are unaffected. (The TTL is not scaled by the profile.)

notes: kill = SIGKILL; graceful stop = SIGTERM. kill -9 is not power loss (page cache survives).
